responsibility: Declares the generated pass-0 parser entry point for GNU Modula-2. Its single exported `CompilationUnit` routine drives the first syntax-checking pass with error recovery, determining whether the source is structurally sound enough for subsequent passes that build symbols and code.
same_name_distinction: This file is only the minimal module interface for the generated pass-0 parser, exporting CompilationUnit; the same-stem .bnf file holds the actual grammar and embedded actions from which that parser implementation is produced.
